title: Fuel Setup
statement: Let $B,F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose Boolean parameters `forward` and `findMode`, an input word $x$, a base loop-host configuration, an input-head position $p$, a Boolean flag tape, and Boolean words $w,o$. Starting in controller phase $0$ with blank counter tape, payload tape storing $w$, counter head at $0$, payload head at $|w|$, and output $o$, after exactly $3|w|+4$ steps the host is in phase $4$ with counter tape storing $w$, blank payload tape, both heads at $0$, and output $o$; all remaining frame data are unchanged. This includes the case $w=[]$.
replaced:
Let $w$ be the captured fuel word. Starting the loop host in controller phase zero on a
frame whose counter track is blank and whose payload track is the buffer tape of $w$
with payload head at cell $|w|$, after exactly $3|w| + 4$ steps the host is in the
input-rewind phase with the counter track holding $w$, the payload track blank, both
heads at cell zero, and all inactive data unchanged. The empty word is included.
